patch.value: GH-859: pm-beads source export can omit Beads comment bodies and events

The current Beads export consumed by pm-beads may omit comment bodies and event history, so migration can appear successful while losing context. The importer must either consume a lossless source or emit a fail-closed completeness receipt before writing PM records.

A source fixture with comments and events imports every body and event with record/content parity; incomplete export formats fail closed with actionable guidance; immutable backup and source/target parity gates are documented and tested; package and installed-consumer acceptance pass
Prevents silent loss of discussion and history during importer adoption
